_comment: AI-DEV enforcement floor. Deployed to /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.d/20-ai-dev-security.json by `make -C ~/.ai-dev sync` (needs sudo). Managed booleans cannot be overridden by user or project settings, so a checked-out repository cannot switch the sandbox off, re-enable the unsandboxed escape hatch, or unblock credential paths. Deny entries merge from every scope and can only ever narrow access. Remove with `make -C ~/.ai-dev unmanage`.
_note_disableBypassPermissionsMode: Claude Code documents this as: 'To prevent bypassPermissions or auto mode from being used, set permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode or permissions.disableAutoMode to "disable" in any settings file. These are most useful in managed settings where they can't be overridden.' A launcher-side flag check is a blacklist on one entry point; this is enforcement. It refuses bypassPermissions however it is reached: --permission-mode bypassPermissions in either spelling, --dangerously-skip-permissions, --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions and the Shift+Tab cycle, a defaultMode in any settings file, and bare `claude` invoked without the launcher at all. disableAutoMode is deliberately NOT set: auto is the AI-DEV default mode.
